dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, will it be hot in Chiang Mai in December?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, wɪl ɪt bi ˈhɑːt ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it won't. December is in the cool season.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈwoʊnt. dɪˈsɛmbər ɪz ɪn ðə ˈkuːl ˌsiːzən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No! But it will be cold in the mountains.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ! bʌt ɪt wɪl bi ˈkoʊld ɪn ðə ˈmaʊntənz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And when is the hot season?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwɛn ɪz ðə ˈhɑːt ˌsiːzən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: From March to May. It will be very hot in April!
dialogue.reading: frəm ˈmɑːrtʃ tə ˈmeɪ. ɪt wɪl bi ˈvɛri ˈhɑːt ɪn ˈeɪprəl!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: In Canada, April is in spring. Spring and fall are cool.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈkænədə, ˈeɪprəl ɪz ɪn ˈsprɪŋ. ˈsprɪŋ ənd ˈfɔːl ər ˈkuːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We don't have spring or fall in Thailand!
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈsprɪŋ ɔːr ˈfɔːl ɪn ˈtaɪlænd!
